title: an infra sprint whose deliverable IS a CI job/workflow completes done with the deliverable's runtime never observed — a PR-only or schedule-only job never fires in the sprint's push context, so reviewing PASS is hollow for that deliverable class
detail: Distinct from fb-41877c6a453f (there, criteria were explicitly verify_in:ci). Here a sprint changed .github/workflows/*.yml adding a PR-only gate job and a schedule-only nightly; both passed reviewing (real for the CODE) and the sprint completed done, but NEITHER had ever executed in its real runtime because their on: triggers cannot fire on a push to the sprint branch. When later dispatched manually, the nightly's FIRST observed run was RED (real contamination failures) — the deliverable was broken and done hid it. This is wired-not-observed recurring one meta-level up: the sprint that BUILDS a CI gate never observes the gate. Fix: at the integrating/sprint-complete gate, detect a changed workflow whose changed job trigger does NOT include a push matching the sprint branch, and REQUIRE either a defer-marker committing to a post-integration observed run OR a recorded observed run (a real green dispatch), before done. Advisory by default, blocking under an opt-in, same shape as push_or_park; escape via a gh-verified mark-ci-observed. Reuses the ci_observed_green machinery.
repro: sprint edits a .github/workflows job whose on: is pull_request/schedule/workflow_dispatch only (no push to the sprint branch); sprint-complete records done with the job never observed
